messages:
nina: Prod eu-west1 latency regressions observed on /v1/embeds after the last nights rollout. I built a narrow hotfix that unsticks the KV cache warm path. Traffic shows 3% error increase on warm-up only. Requesting expedited deploy: staging smoke then a rapid prod canary (10% -> 100%) within 30m. @rahul @kevin please ack.
deploy-bot: Policy for service=embeds: canary_required. Override path available with 2 ENG + 1 SRE approval.
rahul: Can you confirm no DB or config changes? Need rollback plan.
nina: No DB or secret changes. Image only: redwood/embed:v2.4.9-hotfix-182500. Rollback: pin back to redwood/embed:v2.4.8. Also have a toggle on the feature-gate 'embeds.kv_warm_fix' if we need immediate mitigation.
kevin: I'll run staging smoke and targeted KV warm probes. smoke script: `./ops/smoke_embeds_kv.sh --region eu-west1` TTL ~2m.
amelia: SRE: what's our auto-rollback threshold?
oncall-sre: Prefer auto-rollback if eu-west1 5xx or error-rate on warm-up path > 1% for 2m. I can sign off if staging passes and we keep the initial canary small.
kevin: staging smoke started.
kevin: staging smoke PASS. KV warm sequences exercised, no 5xx in 3m.
rahul: +1 after smoke.
nina: Requesting expedite and pin. I'll include flag toggle as a mitigation. Command: ```/deploy --service embeds --image redwood/embed:v2.4.9-hotfix-182500 --target staging --pin --notes "hotfix: kv warm path fix"```
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: staging. Policy indicates canary for prod. Override path requires explicit flag.
rahul: If staging looks good, I'll approve override for prod.
kevin: staging deploy succeeded (sha=aa11bb). healthcheck=smoke-sigs.
kevin: Proposing rollout plan: enable feature-gate on 5% hosts, monitor 8m, if stable move to 25% then 100% (3m taps). If any signal breach, first disable gate, then image-rollback if needed.
nina: Sounds good. I'll prepare release-note stub and changelog entry. Link will be posted.
rahul: Approving override after staging. +1 :thumbsup:
oncall-sre: +1 from SRE. I'll run synthetic KV-warm probes and set alert.
nina: Performing expedite to prod with override. Command: ```/deploy --service embeds --image redwood/embed:v2.4.9-hotfix-182500 --target prod --pin --override-canary --rollout 100% --notes "expedite: kv warm path fix; feature-gate ready"```
deploy-bot: 6a7 Override flag provided. Approval log: rahul/nina/oncall-sre. Scheduling prod deploy with pinned image. Auto-rollback thresholds configured: eu-west1 warm-up error-rate > 1% for 2m.
deploy-bot: Prod rollout started. rolling to 5% -> 25% -> 100%.
oncall-sre: Synthetic probes running. Alert: warm-up error-rate baseline 0.2%. Will escalate at >1%.
kevin: 5% step ok, KV warm metrics stable.
kevin: 25% step stable. No spike.
deploy-bot: Prod rollout completed to 100%. No rollback triggered.
nina: Release notes draft: https://docs.internal/releases/182500-kv-warm-fix  will publish after 30m watch. Thanks for fast responses.
oncall-sre: I'll keep alerts on and mute noisy alarms, will open incident if error-rate crosses threshold.
rahul: Great. Closing thread after watch window. If anything, DM me."
